verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five benefits of porridge.

verses.pali: Khuddaṁ paṭihanati, pipāsaṁ paṭivineti, vātaṁ anulometi, vatthiṁ sodheti, āmāvasesaṁ pāceti.
verses.english: It wards off hunger, quenches thirst, settles the wind, cleans the bladder, and helps digestion.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā yāguyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits of porridge.”
